integrity: Sharp lower bound is an analytic Fourier-parity dual inequality with exact rational certificates, witnessed by an explicit positive trigonometric polynomial. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The sharp optimum is restricted to the eight coordinate-simplex nodes and fixed two-negative/six-positive contrast on the compact seven-torus. Nonperiodic kernels, arbitrary configurations and uniqueness of the continuous extremizer are not claimed. Prior-literature coverage beyond inspected sources remains a risk.
title: A sharp two-negative Fourier-kernel bound on the seven-dimensional torus
